Frontend Playwright covered: home HU (brand-section, Kosárba, no forbidden EN words, category HU names), HU↔EN switch persisted after reload, header search focus, shop sort/count (28 termék), product detail (pd-stock/description/related/back/add-to-cart), cart persistence across reload+navigation (localStorage hi_cart_v1), checkout summary + ship-home checked + ship-pickup disabled with 'Fejlesztés alatt' badge + co-total, admin login (wrong token toast, correct token → stats + all 6 tabs + signout), all legal pages render legal-template-note, unknown route → 404, mobile-menu toggle+close+Escape, footer newsletter (error without consent, footer-newsletter-done with consent).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 679 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting admin router, payments, and seeding into separate modules for maintainability.

In-memory _fails dict for admin brute-force protection resets on backend restart and is per-worker only; if the app is ever scaled to >1 worker/replica the 8-attempt lockout will not be enforced globally. Fine for MVP.

create_order does not use a transaction; stock decrement happens after order insert. If a concurrent order over-consumes stock, the second order will still be inserted with items whose stock went negative (check happens once, decrement is $inc unconditional). Consider using findOneAndUpdate({stock: {$gte: qty}}, {$inc: {stock: -qty}}) atomically.

GET /api/orders/{id} correctly hides ipn/simplepay_response/history/admin_note but still exposes full customer PII (email, phone, address) with only the order_id as a guessing key. Consider adding a per-order lookup token (e.g. order_ref last-6) or short-lived signed link.
Public /api/products/random has limit param defaulting to 100 but fetches up to 1000 first — fine for now; ensure not abused.
